name: ibis budget Singapore Ruby
short_description: A 168-room 2-star budget hotel in Geylang, about a 10-minute walk from Aljunied MRT, formerly Fragrance Hotel - Ruby.
ai_summary: ibis budget Singapore Ruby sits in Eastern Geylang at 10 Lorong 20 Geylang, about a 10-minute walk from Aljunied MRT Station and roughly a 4-minute drive from the Bugis shopping district. The 168-room economy hotel -- rebranded from the former Fragrance Hotel - Ruby -- offers compact 11-12 sqm rooms with free WiFi, air-conditioning and free on-site parking, in a neighborhood known for round-the-clock local food. Its own Accor listing shows a 4.3/5 guest rating from 67 reviews, and an independent blog trip report from January 2026 calls it reliable, clean, budget accommodation, while flagging Geylang's red-light-district reputation and limited workspace as things to know before booking. The hotel does not participate in the ALL - Accor Live Limitless loyalty programme.

core_facts.elite_notes: This hotel does not participate in the ALL - Accor Live Limitless loyalty programme, per its own Accor listing; ALL member rates may still apply but no points-earning or elite benefits are offered.

faqs.question: Is ibis budget Singapore Ruby part of the ALL loyalty programme?
faqs.answer: No -- despite carrying the ibis budget/Accor brand, this hotel's own Accor listing confirms it does not participate in the ALL - Accor Live Limitless loyalty programme, so members cannot earn or redeem points or elite benefits here, though ALL member rates may still apply.

faqs.question: How far is ibis budget Singapore Ruby from Aljunied MRT?
faqs.answer: It's about a 10-minute walk from Aljunied MRT Station in Geylang, with the Bugis shopping district roughly a 4-minute drive away and Marina Bay Sands about 6 minutes by car, making it a workable budget base for exploring central Singapore.
